1.title: Hollow Knight: Voidheart Edition
1.quote: The epitome of a metroidvania masterpiece

descriptions.gameplay: A simple combat system contrasts with the high level of challenge the game presents. Plenty of interesting bosses, intricate locations that are fascinating to explore, and new abilities that enhance combat and unlock new paths. That's what I call a high-quality metroidvania!
descriptions.story: The story is woven into the environment, discovered through notes in the Hunter's Journal, texts on mysterious monoliths, and a handful of beautiful cutscenes. However, the plot isn't essential for progression, as the game's navigation is intuitive.
descriptions.graphics: Simple yet elegant visuals. Great attention to detail and captivating animated backgrounds create a visual style you'll remember for years to come.
descriptions.music: A gorgeous ambient-inspired soundtrack with unforgettable bangers during boss fights. Huge thanks to Christopher Larkin for the incredible work he's done—every track has found a place in both my heart and my playlists!
